units.source_text: 大家都知道，地狱里面不光有刀山血池，在暗无天日的天空下，还有火海地狱火焰谷、极寒地狱冰海与它并称。

en.t: As everyone knows, hell contains not only mountains of blades and pools of blood, but beneath its sunless sky there are also the flaming valley of the sea of fire and the icy sea of the freezing hell, which are spoken of alongside them.

units.source_text: 鬼卒们把杜子春逐一扔进这些地狱里，

en.t: The demon guards threw Toshishun into each of these hells one after another,

units.source_text: 杜子春被刀穿胸，被火焰烧脸，被拨皮拔舌，

en.t: Toshishun had his chest pierced by blades, his face burned by flames, his skin flayed and his tongue pulled out,

units.source_text: 被铁杵棒打，被油锅煎熬，被毒蛇噬脑、被鹰熊挖眼——

en.t: he was beaten with iron pestles, tormented in cauldrons of oil, had his brain bitten by venomous snakes, and had his eyes gouged out by hawks and bears—

units.source_text: 这些酷刑一一遭受了一个遍。

en.t: he suffered every one of these cruel tortures in turn.

units.source_text: 如果说这其中的痛苦，那真是难以言表。

en.t: As for the pain in all of this, it was truly beyond words.

units.source_text: 就算是这样，杜子春依然顽强的绷紧牙关，缄默不言。

en.t: Even so, Toshishun still stubbornly clenched his teeth and remained silent.
